meeting_exceptions_cancelled_is_bare.name: meeting_exceptions_cancelled_is_bare
meeting_exceptions_cancelled_is_bare.value: not "meeting_exceptions"."cancelled" or ("meeting_exceptions"."starts_local" is null and "meeting_exceptions"."duration_minutes" is null)

notes_shelved_on_its_own.name: notes_shelved_on_its_own
notes_shelved_on_its_own.value: "notes"."anchor_type" is null or ("notes"."folder_id" is null and "notes"."pinned_at" is null)

notes_anchor_shape.name: notes_anchor_shape
notes_anchor_shape.value:
("notes"."anchor_type" is null and "notes"."anchor_id" is null and "notes"."occurrence_id" is null)
          or ("notes"."anchor_type" is not null and "notes"."anchor_id" is not null
              and ("notes"."occurrence_id" is null or "notes"."anchor_type" = 'meeting'))

person_roles_span_check.name: person_roles_span_check
person_roles_span_check.value: "person_roles"."from_month" is null or "person_roles"."to_month" is null or "person_roles"."from_month" <= "person_roles"."to_month"

people_time_zone_source_check.name: people_time_zone_source_check
people_time_zone_source_check.value:
("people"."time_zone" is null and "people"."time_zone_source" is null)
          or ("people"."time_zone" is not null and "people"."time_zone_source" in ('city', 'manual'))

people_birthday_daymonth_check.name: people_birthday_daymonth_check
people_birthday_daymonth_check.value:
"people"."birthday_day" is null
          or ("people"."birthday_calendar" = 'lunar' and "people"."birthday_day" <= 30)
          or ("people"."birthday_calendar" = 'solar' and "people"."birthday_day" <=
              (array[31, 29, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31])["people"."birthday_month"])

people_birthday_group_check.name: people_birthday_group_check
people_birthday_group_check.value:
("people"."birthday_calendar" is null and "people"."birthday_month" is null and "people"."birthday_day" is null)
          or ("people"."birthday_calendar" is not null and "people"."birthday_month" is not null and "people"."birthday_day" is not null)

reading_items_shape_check.name: reading_items_shape_check
reading_items_shape_check.value:
("reading_items"."kind" = 'link' and "reading_items"."url" is not null and "reading_items"."author" is null)
          or ("reading_items"."kind" = 'book' and "reading_items"."url" is null and "reading_items"."title" is not null)

relations_origin_shape.name: relations_origin_shape
relations_origin_shape.value:
("relations"."origin" = 'mention' and "relations"."field" is not null and "relations"."excerpt" is not null)
          or ("relations"."origin" = 'manual' and "relations"."field" is null and "relations"."excerpt" is null)

resources_pinned_check.name: resources_pinned_check
resources_pinned_check.value: "resources"."pinned_rank" is null or ("resources"."owner_type" = 'project' and "resources"."pinned_rank" between 1 and 9)
